status: frozen before any v19 Gaia query, X-ray/Gaia cross-match, relative X-ray cross-match, transform application, registered science-image inspection, shock fit, source construction, or replacement-cluster lensing access
purpose: Place every cleaned Bullet Cluster and Abell 2146 Chandra observation on one external ICRS frame without allowing astrometric scale, rotation, or shear to mimic a halo size or direction.

archive.selection: all Gaia DR3 sources in each frozen cone; no magnitude, proper-motion, color, RUWE, or morphology cut

BULLET.center_definition: component-wise median RA_NOM and DEC_NOM across the ten frozen archived event headers

ABELL2146.center_definition: component-wise median RA_NOM and DEC_NOM across the ten frozen archived event headers

reference_selection.rule: greatest cleaned exposure within each cluster, with lower ObsID breaking an exact tie

epoch_propagation.target_epoch: midpoint of DATE-OBS and DATE-END for the Gaia anchor ObsID, expressed as Julian year
epoch_propagation.five_or_six_parameter_sources: linear tangent-plane propagation using Gaia DR3 pmra=mu_alpha*cos(dec) and pmdec
epoch_propagation.two_parameter_sources: retain the Gaia DR3 reference-epoch position and uncertainty; do not invent a proper motion
epoch_propagation.parallax_and_perspective_acceleration: not applied because the 2-arcsec candidate radius and 0.5-arcsec residual gate dominate them for this registration

xray_source_selection.catalog: the frozen binsize-2 0.5-7 keV wavdetect catalogs from v19F cleaning

matching.role: absolute Gaia match for the one source-blind reference observation per cluster

relative_matching.role: relative match of each remaining observation to its Gaia-corrected reference catalog
relative_matching.input_sources: the same frozen wavdetect catalogs with SRC_SIGNIFICANCE>=3 and NET_COUNTS>0

application.reference_observation: apply only its frozen Gaia translation
application.other_observations: apply only their frozen translation into the Gaia-anchored reference frame
application.files: update every aspect solution and copied clean science/blank-sky event WCS; set ASOLFILE to the corrected aspect list
application.derived_products: recreate all later images, exposure maps, FOVs, masks, and spectra from the corrected products
application.failure_rule: Fail the cluster map if either Gaia anchor or any relative observation has fewer than three final pairs, exceeds 0.5-arcsec RMS, or requires non-translation freedom; do not widen the radius, lower source significance, or fit rotation, scale, or shear.

next_protocol_boundary: If all v19G gates pass, freeze the common map grid, edge likelihood, adaptive spectral bins, thermodynamic uncertainty propagation, and projection-clock ensemble before inspecting a registered science image.
